verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a public REST API with an OpenAPI specification, an SDK generated from it, and a CLI for operating an existing instance, and a probe confirms that openapi.json is live. Nothing shows the API covers everything the UI can do, and the documented UI features (dashboard, tasks, pages, agent builder, scheduling, sharing) are never mapped to API endpoints. Missing for 10: evidence of UI-to-API parity, endpoint coverage for UI features like tasks, scheduling, sharing and agent building, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
